title: Nf Round4 Primary
objective: Implement and certify the modified Round-4 deep-primary power-basis search, eliminating Round-2 delegation on supported PARI corpus and public timeout vectors

handoff.summary: An ordinary-Python Ford--Letard power-basis search handles PARI #2510 and vector 008 without constructive Round-2 fallback. Exact E*F, p-local containment, p-power denominators/index, discriminant change, canonical HNF, and stable stage evidence fail closed. Incremental regular-representation assembly and exact-coordinate memoization reduce deep-primary cost while deterministic metrics expose calls and input sizes.
risks: Vector 008 remains a measured performance debt: optimization reduced the power-basis kernel from about 19.98s to 15.36s and the strict public wrapper from 22.27s to 17.72s on the shared Linux x64 host.
Multiple modular primary components and higher-residue-field root matching remain explicit unsupported boundaries delegated to Round 2.

Vector 010 passes the former ramification-degree-decrease and finite-field-root boundaries but still does not complete within 180 seconds. Precision-bounded beta representatives lower the limit-45 maximum from 70,585 to 8,097 coordinate bits and total from 147,655 to 79,649; the next repeated residue-beta exact charpoly remains above 30 seconds.
next_steps: Implement PARI-style modular characteristic polynomials for the repeated residue-beta stage that still bounds vector 010 after representative growth is controlled.
Move repeated exact characteristic-polynomial work toward the source-transparent native boundary; a single degree-32 probe measured about 217ms.
Integrate the public dispatcher/selector separately through the shared integration lane.
